messages:
alex: Heads-up — starting a coordinated base-image refresh next week for the runtime fleet. Need to lock down RBAC for the KMS signing key, confirm audit-log retention, and prep vuln triage and incident-playbook hooks. Anyone on-call for the handoff?

priya: I can own the RBAC change. Which key are we rotating/signing with?

alex: New key is `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/runtime/cryptoKeys/runtime-sign-v3`. It's already created but restricted to sec-key-admins. We'll need service-account access for the build pipeline and the node-operator role for the runtime agents.

marta: Do we have a list of build pipeline SAs? I want to avoid granting broad access.

alex: Yes — `ci-builder@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `artifact-uploader@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. I propose a grant flow: 1) Add `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` to `ci-builder` scoped to the cryptoKey only; 2) Add `roles/compute.osAdminLogin` NOT needed on nodes — we only need runtime agent to call `asymmetricSign`.

priya: Sounds good. I'll draft the IAM binding and post the PR. Quick Q: do we need to update our HSM/KMS audit sinks? Current sinks capture admin logs but not `cryptoKey` usage detail for asymmetricSign calls.

james: We get the `CryptoKeyVersion` access logs in cloud audit, but the big gap is forwarding to our long-term immutable storage. ops-bot: remind me if the sink is healthy?

ops-bot: sink-status: kms-audit-sink -> healthy, last-forward: 2026-03-20T22:12:03Z, retention-policy: 365d :white_check_mark:

marta: 365d is fine for now, but compliance asked for 2y for runtime signing events. Can we set an exception or extend?

priya: Extend to 730d for the `kms-audit-sink` namespace. We need approval from privacy and finance for extra storage costs. I'll ping legal.

alex: Also we need to update runtime agents to emit an assertion in audit logs with image digest and builder SA. Minimal structure: `signed_by`, `key_version`, `image_digest`, `build_id`. That ties the signature to the artifact for vuln triage.

marta: Agree. For vuln triage, can we annotate the image vulnerability ticket with `signed_by` and `build_id` automatically? Our triage bot can attach metadata if the scan payload includes it.

james: Scanner accepts extra metadata if it's in the manifest. Propose adding a `x-redwood-signature` JSON blob in the image manifest annotated during upload. Example: `{"signed_by":"ci-builder","key_version":"v3","build_id":"2026-03-21-9843"}`.

priya: One more RBAC question — do runtime nodes need to verify signatures? They should only verify client requests, not re-sign. Verify action requires `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.getPublicKey` which is not logged separately. We can cache pubkeys in the agent and avoid extra KMS calls for latency.

alex: Yes, cache with a TTL and a rotation watcher. If we rotate key, agents should fetch new pubkey and validate existing cached signatures. Fallback policy: if pubkey fetch fails, enter degraded mode and alert — do NOT auto-fail traffic.

marta: For incident response: if a signing key is compromised, plan is: 1) revoke key versions, 2) mark affected images as untrusted in the registry, 3) emergency rollout of a minimal fallback image signed by emergency key, 4) notify customers per SLA. Do we have a runbook?

priya: We have a skeleton in `runbooks/crypto-key-compromise.md` but it's outdated. I'll sync with triage and update the steps. Can someone volunteer to own the emergency key policy?

james: I can own emergency key policy. I'll prepare an ops playbook and a list of emergency signers (2-of-3 approvers).

alex: Great. Next, vuln triage cadence: let's run a focused scan on the new base images before mass rollout. Can security approve a canary batch of 20 hosts for a week?

marta: Yes — approve canary: 20 hosts in `us-central1-a`. We'll watch exploitability scores and startup logs. sec-bot: schedule scans?

sec-bot: scan-schedule: trigger image-scan for image `runtime-base:v2026-03-21` on canary cohort `canary-runtime-20` at 03:00 UTC daily for 7 days.

ops-bot: deployment plan: rollout waves: [20, 100, 500, global]. Gate: no sev2+ vulns in last 48h and KMS sink extended.

priya: I'll open a PR with IAM bindings and a terraform diff and link it here. Please review quickly — aiming to land Fri EOD.

marta: I'll take the vulnerability monitoring and add dashboards. Also will add an alert: `image-scan.sev2_count > 0 in 48h for cohort` -> page oncall.

alex: Final ask: update the audit log retention approval thread with finance/legal approvals so we can extend to 730d. Tagging @legal-team and @finance-team in the PR.

james: I'll draft the emergency sign-off policy doc and ping sec-reviewers.

priya: PR posted: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/infra/changes/4321 — includes IAM, terraform change, and a small runtime agent pubkey cache TTL bump. Please review.

marta: Reviewed +1 on IAM scoping. Left a nit on variable naming.

alex: Thanks all. I'll coordinate the canary start Monday 03:00 UTC. If anything blocks, reply in-thread. :thumbsup:

priya: noted — I'll merge after approvals.

sec-bot: triage-ticket-created: #SEC-2026-480 (image-signing-audit-coverage); assignees: [marta, james]

marta: grabbing #SEC-2026-480, will update with dashboard links once ready.

james: prepping emergency key doc, ETA Tue EOD.

alex: Closing loop — follow-up sync scheduled Mon 02:30 UTC in #eng-security.

marta: thanks all!
